statements.text:
.@RepJerryNadler & I are leading 30 colleagues to tighten oversight on artificial intelligence & algorithms used in Medicare Advantage plans that wrongly deny care.

We outlined 6 strategies so @CMSGov can ensure plans comply w/ Medicare’s rules & don't create barriers to care. https://t.co/QIRMzuz9xk

Increased AI and algorithm use in Medicare Advantage plans is causing alarmingly high payment denials – forcing seniors to pay for care themselves or go without.

That’s why @RepJerryNadler and I are urging @CMSGov to increase oversight of AI tools & prevent unfair care barriers.
statements.quoted:
Amid concerns about claims denials, Democrats seek greater oversight of Medicare Advantage plans' use of AI
https://t.co/rDmADjmwvh

statements.text: @RepJerryNadler @SenWarren @CMSGov It's scary: The uncertainty of AI in healthcare raises serious questions about accuracy and compliance. We urge @CMSGov to prohibit the use of AI in coverage denials until they can verify that that these algorithms reliably adhere to Medicare coverage standards.

@RepJerryNadler @SenWarren @CMSGov This builds on the letter @RepJerryNadler and I sent to @CMSGov in November 2023.

It's unacceptable that thousands of seniors with MA insurance are being forced to either pay for their care themselves or go without it because an unregulated AI tool said so. We need guardrails.

Today, @RepJerryNadler, @SenWarren, and I led a bicameral, bipartisan letter with 45 House Members and 4 Senators to @CMSGov urging heightened scrutiny of AI and algorithmic software that influence coverage decisions in Medicare Advantage plans. https://t.co/qufqganROJ

We remain concerned about MA plans' use of prior authorization, specifically their ongoing use of artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithmic software to guide coverage decisions. Plans continue to use AI tools to erroneously deny care and contradict provider assessment findings.

statements.text: We believe CMS must be more proactive in monitoring plans' use of AI and algorithm-driven tools. MA plans cannot be allowed to side-step oversight by claiming that these tools are mere 'guidance.'
statements.venue: Press release on bicameral letter to CMS co-led by Rep. Chu (joint statement of signers)

statements.text: Medicare Advantage plans are entrusted with providing medically necessary care to their enrollees. We encourage CMS to incorporate the measures outlined above to protect Medicare beneficiaries and prevent future AI-related harms in health care.
